items.source: Note: The data buffers should be released via DataBufferUtils.release(DataBuffer) after they have been consumed. In addition, if using Flux or Mono operators such as flatMap, reduce, and others that prefetch, cache, and skip or filter out data items internally, please add doOnDiscard(DataBuffer.class, DataBufferUtils::release) to the composition chain to ensure cached data buffers are released prior to an error or cancellation signal.
items.translation: 注意： 数据缓冲区在消费后应通过DataBufferUtils.release(DataBuffer)释放。此外，如果使用像 flatMap、reduce 等会内部预取、缓存或跳过/过滤数据项的 Flux 或 Mono 操作符，请在组合链中添加doOnDiscard(DataBuffer.class, DataBufferUtils::release)，以确保在错误或取消信号之前释放缓存的数据缓冲区。

items.source:
Decode a data buffer to an Object of type T. This is useful for scenarios,
that distinct messages (or events) are decoded and handled individually,
in fully aggregated form.
items.translation: 将数据缓冲区解码为类型为 T 的对象。这在需要以完全聚合的形式单独解码和处理不同消息（或事件）的场景中非常有用。
